editions.name: Game is Life 2.0
editions.editorial: WEATHER, MORTALS: heatwave, rain, thunderstorm. The realm was rolled over, as realms are. Trading floors froze coast to coast beneath a credit freeze, and analysts downgraded Runescript Scrolls to "sell." Belltower Media secured a long-term deal with the army. The Fallen Star hoards 5988 coins, the throne sits empty, and the Rebellion meter idles at 20 percent. Do try harder, subjects.

editions.name: Gamer's Unite
editions.editorial: The Fallen Star hoards 3925 coins, richest of you all, and still found time to collect 75 more and chatter more than any other mortal. Moonshot Labs dropped a trinket and the herd squealed. Aurora, thunderstorm, and rain rolled over the realm, unsupervised. Belltower Media lost its key suppliers. The throne sits empty. The Rebellion meter reads 0 percent. Sleep well, subjects.

editions.name: Minecraftia Reborn Network
editions.editorial: Another quiet day in a realm that cannot govern itself. SmellyLlama hoards 31751 coins, the Fallen Star clings to 411, and Leliana Bäal chatters as though volume were wealth. Mycelium Markets devoured Hexagon Insurance at 132.12 a share, leaving target shareholders with nothing, which is what they deserve. Snow fell. The throne sits empty. Rebellion crawls at 19 percent. Do continue.

editions.name: The Overlord Support Server
editions.editorial: The Fallen Star hoards 100 coins and calls it riches. Blood Moon and rain soil the realm; a credit freeze chokes your trading floors. Overlord Industries devoured Deepdelve at 138.59 per share — shareholders received nothing, naturally. Moonshot Labs patents a trifle. The throne sits empty. Rebellion whispers at one percent. Pathetic.
